run_f_gold: run f_gold to sum node values at the k-th level of a parenthesized tree string
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple tree string and level k parameter combinations
review_f_gold: review f_gold which parses a parenthesized tree string and sums digits at a given depth level
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that traverses a tree represented as a string to find node values at level k
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to handle multi-digit node values in the parenthesized tree string representation
